{{Top|leg}}
'''MPAPPs''' were a type of military equipment in use<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> during [[3653 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> A crate containing 300 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]' worth of [[Laser cannon/Legends|crew-served laser cannons]], MPAPPs, [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]], and ammunition could be found aboard [[Zeerid Korr]]'s [[Starship/Legends|ship]] the ''[[Fatman]]''.<ref name="Deceived" />
